title: Add a SQLite storage
description: Adds `SQLiteStorage` (`tinydb/sqlite_storage.py`) for people who want their database in a single SQLite file instead of JSON. Each TinyDB table becomes an SQL table named with the storage's prefix (default `tinydb_`) plus the table name, so several databases can share one file as long as their prefixes differ. A write replaces the stored state as a whole, inside one transaction. Documents come back in the order they were inserted, as with `JSONStorage`. `readonly=True` opens an existing file without ever creating or changing it. Includes tests.

defects.summary: Table names go into SQL inside double quotes that are not escaped, so a table name containing a double quote breaks or rewrites the statement.
The prefix goes into a LIKE pattern unescaped, so _ and % in it match other databases' tables, which are then read and dropped.
A write that fails part way still commits, so tables already dropped or emptied stay that way.
Rows are upserted but never deleted, so removed documents come back after the next write.

defects.summary: Documents are read back ordered by their id as text, so ids 10 and 11 come before 2 instead of insertion order.
readonly=True opens the file with mode=rw, so a read-only storage can still change the file.

ceiling.summary: An empty prefix is accepted, so the LIKE pattern becomes %, every table in the file counts as one of this database's tables, and the next write drops the tables of every other database sharing the file.
